title: Idioms for Everyday Talk
context: Idioms are fixed phrases whose meaning is not the sum of the words. Native speakers use a few of them every day. Learn them with a situation, and use only a few at a time.
contextPersian: اصطلاح‌ها عبارت‌هایی ثابت‌اند که معنایشان مجموع کلمه‌ها نیست. انگلیسی‌زبان‌ها هر روز چند تا از آن‌ها را به کار می‌برند. آن‌ها را با یک موقعیت یاد بگیر و هر بار فقط چندتا استفاده کن.

expressions.example: The exam? It was a piece of cake.
He told a joke to break the ice.
expressions.examplePersian: او برای شکستن یخ جمع یک جوک گفت.

expressions.examplePersian: پیش از شروع، مطمئن شویم همه یک‌جور فکر می‌کنیم.

It was difficult at first, but now I'm getting the hang of it.

expressions.example: She always goes the extra mile for her customers.
expressions.examplePersian: او همیشه برای مشتری‌هایش بیش از انتظار تلاش می‌کند.

expressions.example: I only eat fast food once in a blue moon.

speakingTask.instruction: Use two idioms in a short, natural description of your week.
speakingTask.instructionPersian: دو اصطلاح را در یک توصیف کوتاه و طبیعی از هفته‌ات به کار ببر.
modelSentences: The exam was a piece of cake.
I feel a bit under the weather today.
Now the ball is in your court.

roleplay.aiRole: A friendly colleague who likes to chat
roleplay.objective: Chat about your week and use two idioms naturally
roleplay.context: You are having coffee with a colleague. Talk about how the week was, what was easy, what was hard, and how you feel. Use two idioms from this lesson, but only where they sound natural.
roleplay.opening: Hey! How was your week? Anything exciting?
vocabulary: the ball is in your court
